about: I'm an operator who looks for structure in ambiguous problems. Across 14 years at Citi and KeyBank, I have led teams close to the transaction, worked on markets and balance-sheet decisions, and built portfolio processes where data, judgment, controls, and execution have to stay connected.

The common thread is not a bank function or a particular tool. I learn how an organization works, find where a decision needs more structure, and build a clearer way to make and carry it out. Analytics, process design, and automation matter when they make that system faster, more reliable, or easier to govern.

At KeyBank, that currently includes credit risk-rating and line-freeze automation, exposure management, a completed Regulation B process automation, and early-stage revolving-line-to-term work with Product and Fair Lending. Banking is where I built this operating pattern; it is not the ceiling on where I can apply it.

caseStudies.title: Credit risk-rating and freeze automation
caseStudies.narrative: Risk actions on credit cards and revolving lines need to keep pace as relationships change. The work is turning rating downgrades and line-freeze decisions into a repeatable process with clear rules, ownership, exceptions, procedures, and monitoring.
caseStudies.result: A governed, repeatable workflow for consistent risk action—currently in development.
caseStudies.role: Designing the automation, decision rules, and governance; the initiative has no final outcome metric yet.

caseStudies.title: SWIFT savings through direct settlement
caseStudies.narrative: A client's settlement setup relied on a third party, creating network costs that were easy to miss at the headline-process level. A product-processor review surfaced the opportunity, followed by the sustained client and operational work required to establish direct SWIFT settlement.
caseStudies.result: Approximately $29M in annual network settlement savings.
caseStudies.role: I identified the opportunity and drove the client migration through implementation.

caseStudies.title: Balance-sheet response during the 2023 crisis
caseStudies.narrative: During the 2023 regional-banking crisis, deposits and HQLA had to be repositioned entity by entity to strengthen liquidity and keep more funding within Citi's US entities. The work required close coordination with international Treasury teams, including Dubai and Hong Kong.
caseStudies.result: Roughly $10B optimized; roughly $5B able to remain within Citi's US entities.
caseStudies.role: Core, hands-on contributor to the team effort—not sole owner of the result.

caseStudies.title: Other enhancements
caseStudies.narrative: Across roles, I have looked for recurring work that could be made cleaner and more reliable. The individual changes were often small, but built around the people who had to run and trust the process.
highlights: Commentary automation for repetitive P&L pushes
caseStudies.result: Cumulatively, these improvements saved hundreds of hours while making recurring outputs more consistent and easier to verify.
caseStudies.role: Work I built or directly improved across multiple roles; the time saved is cumulative, not a single-project claim.

careerLetter.label: Professional Profile
careerLetter.deck: Fourteen years across operations, markets, treasury, risk, and portfolio management, using analytics, process design, governance, and automation to make complex work clearer and more executable.
openingParagraphs: I have worked across banking operations, markets, treasury, risk, and portfolio management for 14 years. I started in FX settlement, where I managed approximately 25 staff, and later led a six-person equity-derivatives product-control team before moving into liquidity, market risk, and Business Banking portfolio analytics.

At KeyBank, my current work includes a risk-scoring dashboard in UAT, credit-line risk-rating automation and governance, and early-stage revolving-line-to-term work. I fully automated a manual, Excel-based Regulation B process handling hundreds of applications a day, and I operate an existing exposure model whose signals have identified roughly $55M, with roughly $3M recovered.

At Citi, I identified and drove a SWIFT migration that delivered approximately $29M in annual savings. During the 2023 regional-banking crisis, I was a core contributor to a team that optimized roughly $10B of the balance sheet so roughly $5B could remain within Citi's US entities.
careerLetter.operatingThesis: I tend to work on problems that need both analysis and implementation. I clarify the business decision, understand how the work and data move, and help define the procedures, controls, ownership, and monitoring around the answer.
careerLetter.page2Deck: Fourteen years of progression from people leadership close to the transaction through markets and treasury to portfolio strategy, governance, and cross-functional implementation.

operatingPrinciples.title: Read the system, not just the metric
operatingPrinciples.paragraph: I look at how work moves, where decisions sit, which constraints matter, and how the data was produced before deciding what a number means.

operatingPrinciples.title: Design the decision and control together
operatingPrinciples.paragraph: A recommendation is incomplete until ownership, exceptions, procedures, monitoring, and escalation are clear.

operatingPrinciples.title: Use technology to remove friction
operatingPrinciples.paragraph: I use automation when it shortens a decision cycle, improves the information, or removes repetitive work. The goal is better judgment and reliable execution.

careerLetter.selectedRecordIntro: The selected record shows a progression from people leadership close to the transaction, through markets, treasury, and risk, to portfolio strategy and cross-functional implementation.
closingParagraphs: I have already been doing core pieces of Director-scope work: coordinating across functions without relying on formal authority, designing decisions and controls together, and turning ambiguity into an executable, governed process.

I am interested in Director-level roles across business analytics, strategy, business operations, portfolio management, transformation, Chief of Staff work, and product or commercial leadership. Banking is where I built this pattern; the skill set travels wherever complex organizations need clearer decisions and repeatable systems.

connect.heading: Let's compare notes
paragraphs: I'm interested in work where problems need new solutions and a fresh set of eyes—especially when the answer has to reflect how operations flow, how risk is managed, and how disciplined execution can scale.
If you're working through something like that, I'd be glad to compare notes.
